'''Cullen Burns DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Cullen Burns]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-13132">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13132 DeckTech post 13132], DeckTech (Cullen "Sigmar" Burns, 23 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13132/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13132/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018063808/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13132/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
